1. Usage

1.1. Installation

To use ModuelName, first install it using pip:

(.venv) $ pip install ModuelName

1.2. Memo

To make the file, change the directory to where MakeFIle is, and use the command below:

(C:\py\py_exercise\work\docs>) $ make clean
(C:\py\py_exercise\work\docs>) $ make html
